objective: Render five standalone Career World territory environment plates, then composite the locked landmark and mixed ambient art without using or stitching the former global land map.
accepted_decisions: Each employer/career territory remains a standalone scene in this slice.
The reviewed landmark winners are locked and must not be redesigned.
Ambient transport is a mixed pool and does not require individual approval.
Environment plates contain terrain, roads, water, and dressing zones but no generated landmark buildings.
No global stitch and no reuse of the previous global landmass.
